user.title: Saison-Themes
user.description: Sets up seasonal themes with background images. The integration creates the file themes/saison_themes.yaml. Periods, colors and birthdays are set afterwards via "Configure".

themes_not_loaded.title: Saison-Themes are not loaded
themes_not_loaded.description:
Home Assistant does not know the seasonal themes. The integration created `themes/saison_themes.yaml`, but your `configuration.yaml` does not load the `themes` folder.

Add this to `configuration.yaml` (or add the line below an existing `frontend:`):

```yaml
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes
```

Then restart Home Assistant. This notice disappears automatically.

reload_failed.title: Themes could not be reloaded
reload_failed.description:
